objective: Create one second holistic Chazuo poster concept that improves mechanism-level design sophistication rather than surface resemblance to Shanyeji.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: structural_display_mass
five_high_leverage_variables.target: 茶作 becomes one authored display object through unequal optical mass, proprietary internal cuts/joins and intentional counter/negative-space topology; brush appearance may be absent.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: title_photo_counter_mass_topology
five_high_leverage_variables.target: Title and active tea-process photography must counterbalance as functional masses with overlap/crop/edge interaction; avoid simple left/right partition.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: photo_generated_type_safe_space
five_high_leverage_variables.target: Readable type space must emerge from photographic staging, crop, depth, occlusion and local luminance/frequency rather than a generic dark column.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: reading_order_graph
five_high_leverage_variables.target: First-read title, second-read support and third-read closure form a deliberate relation graph with differing axes/distances, not a stacked caption block.

five_high_leverage_variables.name: regional_density_and_crop_tension
five_high_leverage_variables.target: High-detail photography and high graphic density must alternate regionally; crop and empty space create tension while preserving truthful tea-process depth.

pass_definition: Concept 02 must feel materially closer to Shanyeji's design-system sophistication through explainable structure, hierarchy, counter-mass and spatial relationships—not through surface imitation.
